summary: End-to-end testing of admin debit-balance feature + Activity history search. All 10 backend pytest cases passed (validation, success, insufficient funds, audit endpoint, credit regression). Frontend flows verified via Playwright: Debitar button opens dialog, submit disabled until confirm toggle is checked, successful debit shows 'Debitado 2 USD de Test User · Email enviado' toast, email logged in email_logs with status='sent', admin_debit transaction persisted with reason, system_activity logged (activity type stored as 'type' field), History dialog shows totals (TOTAL ACREDITADO/DEBITADO) and transactions with MOTIVO (reason) for debits, Activity page search filters rows client-side, clear button works, and empty state 'Sin resultados para ...' renders.
critical_code_review_comments: services/notifications.py log_system_activity stores the activity category under the key 'type' while routes call it with kwarg 'activity_type'. Filtering by {'activity_type': 'admin_debit'} returns nothing; must filter by {'type': 'admin_debit'}. This is inconsistent naming that is already in place but will confuse future callers. Consider normalising the field name to 'activity_type' across the schema.

After a successful debit, fetchUsers() is triggered but the list briefly rendered 'Usuarios Registrados (0)' during refresh in one run. Not reproducible on fresh navigation (returns 1000). Consider adding a loading skeleton instead of showing empty count to avoid user confusion.
AdminUsersPage.jsx is approaching size limits; consider extracting Debit / History dialogs into separate components.
handleDebit does its own fetch() instead of using adminAPI.debitBalance - inconsistent with other admin calls; consider unifying.
seed_data_creation: Created via API during tests: 1 admin_credit ($1 USD - 'Regression credit by QA'), 2 admin_debit transactions ($5 USD 'Regression test debit by automated QA', $2 USD 'UI automated QA debit test') on user dea201c1-940b-4ae6-9dc7-403581ebebb9 (Test User).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature is fully functional. Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_admin_debit_balance.py is reusable for regression (10 tests, ~9s runtime). Test User id=dea201c1-940b-4ae6-9dc7-403581ebebb9 now has a growing ledger of TEST_ prefixed admin_credit/admin_debit entries which can be cleaned up if needed. Email sending via Resend works in this preview env (status=sent in email_logs). System activities use collection 'system_activity' with field name 'type' (not 'activity_type').
rca of the issue: No blocking issues found. Minor naming inconsistency in log_system_activity noted but functionally correct.
